analysis.reason: RSI가 27.8에서 30.2로 상승하며 과매도 구간에서 벗어나는 움직임 확인. MACD 히스토그램 또한 개선세를 보이며 횡보 구간에서의 축적 가능성 시사. ADX가 53.6으로 과열된 추세 구간에 진입했으나, +DI(12.6) 대비 -DI(32.4)가 우위를 점하며 하락 압력이 지속되고 있어 추세 전환 신호는 미약함. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 1.25로 증가하며 가격 변동에 대한 관심 증가.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI shows upward movement from 27.8 to 30.2, exiting oversold territory. MACD histogram also improving, suggesting accumulation in a sideways range. ADX at 53.6 indicates an overheated trend, bordering on exhaustion, but -DI (32.4) still outweighs +DI (12.6), indicating persistent downward pressure without a clear trend reversal signal. Volume ratio of 1.25 compared to the 5-day average suggests increased interest in price action.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.06) vs SMA5/20 ($0.06/$0.06): short-term neutral, below SMA50 ($0.07): medium-term weak
· Position vs SMA100 ($0.08)/SMA200 ($0.08): confirms strong medium-to-long term downtrend
· 52-week position (5.1%) + current price level near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (27.8→30.2): attempting to exit oversold, weak upward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0007→-0.0003): improving, potential bottoming within a weak trend
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower $0.05, Middle $0.06): approaching lower band, band width is wide at 42.26%
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.05): based on 52-week low and lower Bollinger Band
· Swing resistance ($0.07): based on SMA50 and Pivot R1, potential for medium-term trend reversal upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low $0.05, 20-day low $0.05): no Higher Low formed, continuing sideways range
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.25x): above-average volume indicates increased volatility, slight increase in confidence
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI oversold exit attempt and MACD improvement signals are positive, but maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to weak weekly indicators and ADX in an overheated trend zone.
